preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz?' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The input string S contains only lowercase English letters or '?'
The length of S is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if any(S[i] != S[len(S)-1-i] and S[i] != '?' and S[len(S)-1-i] != '?' for i in range(len(S)//2)) else True
postconditions.description: Return -1 if it is impossible to make S a palindrome by replacing '?' with any lowercase letter

postconditions.expression: all(S[i] == S[len(S)-1-i] for i in range(len(S)//2)) if return_value != -1 else True
postconditions.description: If return_value is not -1, the constructed string is a palindrome

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(abs(ord(S[i]) - ord(S[i+1])) for i in range(len(S)-1)) if return_value != -1 else True
postconditions.description: If return_value is not -1, it equals the sum of absolute ASCII differences between adjacent characters in the constructed palindrome

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(sum(abs(ord(S[i]) - ord(S[i+1])) for i in range(len(S)-1)) for S in possible_palindromes(S)) if return_value != -1 else True
postconditions.description: If return_value is not -1, it is the minimum possible sum of absolute ASCII differences among all valid palindromic replacements of '?'
